text:
leo: Heads up — customer reported repeated token charges after a stream reconnect + toolcall truncation. Billing ledger shows small partial-line items instead of a single stitched charge.

maya: ugh. is this the same reconnect-window issue from last quarter?

sarah: not exactly. logs show: `stream_resume request_id=rr-9a3 trunc=true toolcall_id=tc-77 kv_evicted=true` then a followup chunk without the `toolcall_id`.

dave: so we lose the toolcall context when KV cache triggers eviction during prefix capture? that would break stitch keys.

leo: yup. Routing fallback happened (eu->us) so we reattached to a different node which had no kv snapshot. Consequence: two ledger rows — one provisional for the truncated pre-tool output, another for resumed tokens. Customer sees two small charges instead of one.

maya: how are we currently deduping/attributing streaming partials? last iirc it's `session_id + toolcall_id + prefix_hash` matching. If toolcall_id is missing we fallback to heuristics.

infra-bot: Incident link: https://incidents/redwood/INC-2026-211 (automated note).

sarah: the heuristics are `time-window + source_ip + model + route`. That was intentionally loose for quick recovery but it allows double-bill on cross-region reconnects.

dave: two avenues: 1) conservative accounting: hold provisional charges until session closes or TTL to allow stitch; 2) stronger idempotency: ensure toolcall_id is attached to every chunk even after eviction (replay metadata).

leo: (1) affects cashflow and reporting latency — worried finance will hate delayed billing. (2) requires changes to runtime metadata propagation and route sticky headers. also needs console UX to surface provisional vs final charges.

maya: can we do a hybrid? provisional immediate small charge but mark as "provisional" in ledger and do automatic reconciliation within N seconds when stitch happens; expose in console with a greyed out provisional badge and hover explanation.

console-team: that'll require new telemetry fields: `provisional=true|false`, `stitch_origin=route_hash`, `reconciled_ts`. Also need a visual treatment and filter on billing dashboard.

leo: and we need a telemetry event for when a toolcall_id is dropped: `toolcall_context_lost` with `request_id, route, node_id, kv_status`. That helps Ops find routers that cause loss.

maya: i can prototype ledger flagging + reconcile job. estimated effort: 2-3 days backend plus 1 day console minimal.

sarah: runtime changes: 1 day to attach toolcall_id to resume handshakes + tests. But we need to decide on routing policy: should fallback routes inherit prior route's stitch key? That requires cross-region sticky datastore or a cheap route-handoff token.

dave: alternative short-term: retry-on-reconnect policy that replays last n tokens as a single resumed chunk with original metadata, preventing missing toolcall_id. not perfect but lower surface area.

leo: short-term plan: maya + sarah implement reconcile flags and `toolcall_context_lost` telemetry; dave will prototype replay-on-resume; console-team add provisional badge. Medium-term: route-handoff token or persistent stitch store.

console-team: noted. we'll add a filter and tooltip to the Billing > Token usage page: "Provisional charges may be adjusted after reconciliation". Please send mock.

maya: @dave can you take routing tests? also add end-to-end test for a reconnect where kv_evicted=true.

dave: yep, i'll add an e2e harness and a synthetic that asserts single ledger row after reconcile job runs.

leo: thanks. will file a short RFC tomorrow to capture pros/cons for finance/legal. tagging @sarah @maya. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Deploy plan: backend feature flag `billing_provisional` default=off. Toggleable per-customer for rollout.

maya: feature flag is good — we can QA on a staging customer.

leo: timeline: quick patch (telemetry + reconcile) by EOW, console badge next sprint, routing policy RFC in 2 weeks.

sarah: i'll open PR for runtime metadata change and include compatibility tests.

leo: perfect. if anyone sees similar double-bill alerts please DM me thread_ts.

maya: linked test case: `tests/e2e/stream_resume_toolcall_reconcile.py` (will push later).

dave: ok pushing a PoC branch now.

leo: great. closing loop for now.
